annotations.title: Find a place to tag on Instagram or Facebook

description: Find a PLACE to tag on an Instagram or Facebook post: a shop, cafe, restaurant, venue or landmark. Give its name with the city ("Blue Bottle Coffee Oakland"), or paste its Facebook Page link, an Instagram place link (instagram.com/explore/locations/...) or its numeric id. Returns a handful of matching Facebook Pages that have an address: pageId, name, address, category, link. Pass the chosen pageId as locationId (Instagram) or place (Facebook) on post_to_meta, or instagramLocationId on schedule_post. These are matches to CONFIRM with the user (check the name and address; a place tag is public), and Instagram checks the place when the post is made. Needs no connected account. Spends about 1 credit per Page it checks (a name search checks up to 5 Pages, so about 5 to 7 credits); a pasted Facebook Page link is about 1 credit; an Instagram place link or a numeric id costs nothing.

limit.description: how many Pages to check on a name search, 1 to 8 (default 5); each is about 1 credit

near.description: optional city or area to narrow a name search, e.g. "Paris"

query.description: the place name with its city (e.g. "Blue Bottle Coffee Oakland"), or a Facebook Page link, an Instagram place link, or a numeric id
